content: Language/RTL: OpusClip supports 25-30+ languages including Arabic for transcription/captions/translation, but full RTL caption rendering (Arabic/Hebrew alignment and word direction) remains an open feature request on its public canny board - RTL output is imperfect. Full Arabic RTL in-product UI is effectively absent from competitors. A 7-language app with complete Arabic RTL (bundled Cairo/Noto fonts, flipped directional icons) is a genuine differentiator for MENA/Japan/Korea markets.
